label: News
depicts: Stacked page sheets with two centered text bars on the front sheet
use_when: Use when the interface wants multiple news sheets stacked behind one front page.
avoid_when: Do not use for the single front page when only one sheet and one side spine should appear.

label: Notebook
depicts: Closed notebook cover with one left spine bar inside a rounded rectangle
use_when: Use when the interface wants a closed notebook cover with a narrow spine bar on the left.
avoid_when: Do not use for the bookmarked notebook when a ribbon tab should hang from the top center.

label: Notebook
depicts: Closed notebook cover with one centered ribbon tab hanging from the top
use_when: Use when the interface wants a closed notebook marked by a ribbon tab hanging inside the cover.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain notebook when only the left spine bar should remain visible.

label: Package
depicts: Open box frame with one lifted top flap and one centered front dot
use_when: Use when the interface wants an open parcel box with one top flap lifted above the front face.
avoid_when: Do not use for the closed cube package when all outer edges should join into one sealed box.

label: Package
depicts: Closed parcel cube with one top seam and one right edge panel
use_when: Use when the interface wants a sealed package cube shown with top seam lines and a right side panel.
avoid_when: Do not use for the open package when a flap should lift upward from the top edge.
